title: IT Service & Support: Georgia and Israel deep edition

questions.q: In "Read your local market Understand", which of these is a key idea?
o: Two different countries, two sets of rules. Pick the country first, then use that country’s list in every module. Check with a local expert.
Check against a worse case: if sales are 25% lower, do you still cover costs?
Licences vary by activity (food, health, money, education centres); list yours before the first order. Check with a local expert.
Keep a risk list with a response for each; include a rules change. Check with a local expert.

questions.q: In "Choose your sector Analyse", which of these is a key idea?
o: Public holidays and the working week differ; put the working days on every delivery promise.
Prove value with a monthly report: tickets closed, time to fix, risks found.
Choose a plan: pay per call, monthly plan or project; pick by regular income.
Payments: bank transfer and local payment methods; show the currency code next to every price.

questions.q: In "Register and license Apply", which of these is a key idea?
o: One measure per week: enquiries, orders or revenue; pick one.
Launch with 3 pilot clients and a 30-day review.
Add tax and duty explicitly; never bury them in a price. Check with a local expert.
Check contract limits, liability and what you may access.

questions.q: In "Protect data and customers Apply", which of these is a key idea?
o: Public holidays and the working week differ; put the working days on every delivery promise.
Both countries have a personal-data law; read the one for the country where the customer lives. Check with a local expert.
Partner with a local college, chamber or training body to find helpers and to practise.
One measure per week: enquiries, orders or revenue; pick one.

questions.q: In "Find and serve customers Create", which of these is a key idea?
o: Trust: registration number, address, delivery days and a refund note on every page. Check with a local expert.
Price plans per device or user; add set-up and a minimum term.
Say in plain words what you collect and why; give a way to see and correct it.
One measure per week: enquiries, orders or revenue; pick one.

questions.q: In "Price, tax and money Evaluate", which of these is a key idea?
o: Cluster H, People and business support: Coaching, coworking and outsourcing fit; many founders need flexible support in more than one language.
Check against a worse case: if sales are 25% lower, do you still cover costs?
Languages differ by customer: write the page in the local language plus English.
Check contract limits, liability and what you may access.

questions.q: In "People and partners Apply", which of these is a key idea?
o: Dates: first test, first order, first review.
Keep a local address and a named contact in the country where you trade.
Contribution per unit = price minus the cost of each unit.
Employment rules, notice and social contributions differ; read the one for the country of the worker. Check with a local expert.

questions.q: In "Launch plan and review Create", which of these is a key idea?
o: Two different countries, two sets of rules. Pick the country first, then use that country’s list in every module. Check with a local expert.
Both have strong technology and start-up activity; many small firms sell abroad from day one.
Keep client passwords in a vault with a log; never email them.
A monthly review: what we planned, what happened, what we change.
